notes: Lofty Denial, printed: 'Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1}. If YOU control a creature with flying, counter that spell unless its controller pays {4} instead.' Seat 0 controls a flier (My Bird) and casts Staunch Shieldmate; seat 1, who controls NO flier, responds with Lofty Denial. The tax is {1}, not {4}: seat 0 pays one (R 4 -> 3) and the Shieldmate resolves.
